title: Building South Mumbai Open World Game, Feat. BomBae
author: jain_harsh21
selftext:
started building an open world game set in South Mumbai

Marine Drive, Gateway of India, the Taj, Wankhede, the tetrapods, monsoon evenings, the Queen's Necklace at night. Built from real map data and old photos, block by block.

this is real gameplay, recorded on my iPhone. you can walk the promenade, fly over the whole city, flip from day to night, or just sit on the seawall and watch the sea for a bit (my favourite part tbh)

it's day one stuff. a lot is rough, a lot is missing. but it's already starting to feel like the city.

more soon. which spot should I build next?
